title: Foodfolio
summary: Discover Singapore food businesses, draft personalised collaboration messages, and track reviewed email and manual social outreach.
coverAlt: Foodfolio's Discover screen shows a cafe search and sample business cards.
coverCaption: Discover screen in Demo Mode with sample businesses.
contributions: Implemented restaurant discovery and sourced contact extraction using Google Places and business websites.
Integrated Gemini drafting with confirmed creator facts, structured outputs, and reviewed message generation.
Implemented Gmail OAuth, encrypted refresh tokens, approval checks, and duplicate-send safeguards.
Connected the frontend to persistent outreach tracking and tasting planning.
Developed backend and frontend tests and the local container setup.
